concerns.text: Plan element uncovered: plan.md's project structure lists `code/requirements.txt` and the constitution's Reproducibility Requirements mandate a pinned dependency file at `projects/.../code/`, but tasks.md drops it as 'scaffold-only' ('the platform supplies common packages'). No task delivers the pinned requirements file, so an implementer cannot satisfy plan Principle I / constitution reproducibility gate. Add a task (or fold into T001/T002) that writes the pinned requirements.txt.

T007 runs a three-arm sweep (pruning {off, FR-004, redundancy-variant}) but plan.md specifies only '2 pruning flags' and never mentions the redundancy variant. The tasks introduce an experimental arm with no plan-level element backing it — the reverse-coverage direction. Either plan.md must be updated to authorize the third arm, or the tasks must cite where this arm is sanctioned; as written, T006/T007 partially lack a plan anchor.

Path-coverage mismatch: T001/T012/T013 reference `specs/001-llmxive-follow-up-extending-from-chatbot/...` while plan.md's structure and header use `specs/001-gene-regulation/`. The tasks' coverage of the plan's documentation-structure element points at a path the plan does not declare; align the identifiers so the quickstart/research.md tasks (T012, T013) match a single canonical spec directory.
